note: I028: who travels with the Captain. Travellers are made from these pools by Travellers.make() on a seed, then kept in the save as they are (a person never changes). Names are not translated; 'text' fields are (gettext). Traits: comfort (simple/comfortable/spacious), privacy (shared_ok/prefers/requires a private cabin), weather (anxious/steady/hardy), timing (strict/normal/relaxed), detour (dislikes/accepts/enjoys), pets (likes/neutral/allergic), talk (chatty/quiet), reviews (generous/fair/critical). Budget is euros a traveller would pay per nautical mile and person, before the comfort of the boat.
